# Raffu (raffu.com)

> Raffu connects customers with vetted local tailoring studios for clothing alterations, repairs, and invisible darning. Features fixed upfront pricing, in-person or courier fittings, and a 48-hour fit guarantee.

## Overview
- **Domain**: https://raffu.com
- **Brand**: Raffu
- **Service Model**: Partner tailoring studios. Customers visit a nearby studio for an in-person fitting or schedule courier garment pickup and delivery.
- **Guarantee**: 48-hour fit guarantee. Any needed adjustments are made free of charge.
- **Turnaround**: 2 to 3 days standard; same-day or next-day express available at select studios.

## Core Alteration Services
1. **Jeans & Trouser Hemming**: Shortening, tapering, and original-hem reattachment on distressed denim.
2. **Suits & Blazers**: Sleeve shortening, waist suppression, chest tapering, and collar roll adjustments.
3. **Dresses & Skirts**: Hem adjustments, strap shortening, and bodice fitting.
4. **Shirts & Blouses**: Sleeve shortening, side tapering, and back darts.
5. **Invisible Darning (Raffu)**: Thread-by-thread hand mending for tears, moth holes, and worn fabric.
6. **Zippers & Repairs**: Zipper replacement, slider repair, and pocket fixes.

## Key Facts
- **No Self-Measuring**: Tailors measure and pin in person at the studio, or customers can include a well-fitting sample garment with courier pickup.
- **Upfront Pricing**: Clear, standardized rates displayed before booking with no surprise fees.
- **Vetted Studios**: Every partner studio is reviewed in person for machinery and craftsmanship quality.
